_comment: The SHA-256 of every published version of Lumi's legal texts (packaging/legal_texts.py hashes them as lumi/terms.py does). An entry is added when a version is first published and never changes: a changed text is a new version (EULA section 16.3). packaging/legal_texts.py check fails when a text, or its pin in lumi/legal/terms.json, differs from its version's entry or has none; release-check also compares this file with the last release tag's copy and that tag's terms.json.
